decisions: mode_select.inf help boxes are one row per line (23-byte slots); English sentences are cut across the same rows, and rows shared between several boxes (S00010, S00012, S00018, S00023, S00075, S00081) were worded so every box using them still reads as a sentence.

mode_select.inf, vs_setting1 and parts of result.inf reference Gundam SEED content (Kira Yamato, Athrun Zala, SEED Points, SEED Dictionary, Heliopolis, Jachin Due) - probably leftover data from a SEED game on the same engine; translated normally.
Leading full-width centring spaces dropped; the two ASCII spaces indenting line 2 of the card-gallery help texts (S00470-S00476) were kept as in the source.
Full-width ASCII (RETRY, YES, Lv.1, digits) converted to plain ASCII; Japanese corner brackets converted to double quotes.
Personality names: Gentle / Calm / Hot-Blooded. Stat names: Shooting / Melee / Defense / Mobility / CP / NT.
uncertain: S00009, S00011, S00014, S00015, S00046, S00047: Kira Yamato / Athrun Zala not in glossary; used the official English names.
S00167: glossary gives only 'Kamuna'; used 'Kamuna Tachibana' (Tachibana romanized).
S00154-S00161: SEED location names (Heliopolis, Jachin Due, Endymion Crater, Victoria Base) not in glossary; used official SEED spellings.
S00039, S00083, S00084: SEED Dictionary - literal rendering of the in-game name; no official English name known.
S00137/S00138, S00147/S00150: unclear whether these fragments are concatenated on one line or drawn separately; added a trailing/leading space for concatenation - check in game.
S00018: shared tail 'here.' used for three different sentences; needs an in-game check of the Options auto-save help (S00095 + S00018).
S00491: Crossbone kept short; could be 'Crossbone Vanguard' if the selection box is wide enough.
